title: Stella Oliver, sugar sandwiches and Sugar Blues
summary: Armstrong's memories of Stella Oliver's cooking and Oliver's sugar sandwiches, linked to Sugar Blues by Clarence Williams.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And he talked about her a lot and what a great cook she was. And he told me about the sugar sandwiches and all that that Oliver used to eat. He described to me in great detail how he used to take a loaf of French bread and cut it in half and cover it with butter and then put a whole lot of sugar on it and that was a sugar sandwich. Oh God.
Which is how the Sugar Blues came to be.
It was written for Oliver. For Oliver? Yeah.
By Clarence Williams. Getting back to Louie, were you here? Did you see him on Mardi Gras Day when he was here? Oh yeah, I saw him. Sure thing.
